query: Last weekend I took my golden retriever to the new dog park downtown, and he had so much fun chasing after a frisbee that he ended up covered in mud and had to get a full bath as soon as we got home. I also tried that new matcha bakery that opened up on the corner of 5th Street yesterday, their red bean mochi is so soft and flavorful I already went back to buy a second box this morning. Oh, and I just finished rearranging my balcony herb garden, the basil and mint are growing so fast I think I’ll be able to harvest enough to make pesto next week. Anyway, I need to exchange an item from my delivered order #W7181492: I want to swap the item 8118291112 for item 8277474082, and use paypal_3024827 as the payment method for any extra costs related to this exchange.
